label: Hub intent vocabulary exists as three unjoined copies: ROUTER.md §3 INTENT_SIGNALS (16/13/12/15/18/17/16 keywords per mode), hub-router.json vocabularyClasses (14/12/11/11/13/12/7) and mode-registry.json modes[].aliases (12/5/6/5/6/9/4). hub-router.json is a strict subset of ROUTER.md for all seven modes, and ROUTER.md:103-105 names only RESOURCE_MAP as a sync target, never hub-router.json, so the drift has no repair instruction. Inside ROUTER.md alone, prose at 88-89 says harness intent fires on four phrases while the §3 block at 119 lists sixteen.

advisor_recommend on "opencode go route this task" ranks sk-code first (score 0.783341, confidence 0.941) over cli-external-orchestration (score 0.31612, confidence 0.82, route cli-deepseek-harness, selectionKind single). The hub's internal route is correct but loses the top slot, so an agent following the top recommendation never reaches the hub. v1.8.0.0's headline promise that 'opencode go route' selects cli-deepseek-harness holds inside the hub and fails at the advisor's ranking.

The executor-delegation scorer reads mode-registry.json modes[].aliases at executor-delegation.ts:212 and spreads them into matching at line 357, so aliases are live and must be widened rather than deleted; removing them would break the delegation scorer's phrase matching outright. Because the alias sets are the narrowest of the three vocabularies, 30 phrases that route in the hub (pi thinking, dsh review, cli-deepseek-harness, composer dispatch) are invisible to the delegation scorer.

cli-pi/references/cli-reference.md:201 cites fanout-run.cjs:2390 for the 20 MB captured-stdout cap, but line 2390 is now 'webSearch: effectiveWebSearchPolicy(lineage),' inside a build function. The citation resolves to a live path and valid line, so validate.sh SOURCE_TAGS passes it, which is how a stale line survives a green gate.

ROUTER.md carries version 1.7.11.0 while SKILL.md, description.json, mode-registry.json and hub-router.json all carry 1.8.0.0, even though 1.8.0.0 materially edited ROUTER.md (seventh mode at 30-31, DEEPSEEK_HARNESS class at 119, its leaves at 148-149, containment paragraph at 85-89). SKILL.md:158 says ROUTER.md keeps its own document version, so the doc version is supposed to track its own content; nothing in the repo compares the two.

advisor_recommend on "ask cursor to fix the bug" returns two recommendations above the 0.8 confidence bar: cli-external-orchestration (0.95, route cli-cursor) and cli-classifier (0.82). Gate 2 states confidence >= 0.8 requires invoking the skill, so two qualifying recommendations make the rule unsatisfiable as written and no surface states a tiebreak.

v4.0.0.1 fan-out scoping holds at the hub: zero fanout-run references remain in any cli-*/SKILL.md; all surviving hits are in references/ docs, the manual-testing playbook or the feature catalog and are scoped to multi-lineage/parallel dispatch or stress testing.
